issues.description: In the template repository, `ray_sphere_intersect` is declared with 3 parameters in `example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h` (origin, dir, center), but it is defined with 4 parameters in `example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp` and called with 4 arguments (origin_f, dirn, center, radius2) from `example_program/src/main.cpp`. This causes a compilation error due to conflicting function declarations when including the header.
issues.suggestedFix: Update `example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h` in the template repository to match the implementation and call sites by adding the missing 4th parameter, e.g. `bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius);` (or rename to `radius2` consistently).
